name: memory-live-check
description: Three short threads in one project: a decision and a correction recorded in jj, recall from a fresh thread, an explicit note, and recall of that note.

turns.prompt: We're starting the Halyard broker tooling here. Decision: the retention flag is spelled retention_hours (snake_case) because the ops scripts parse it. Create NOTES.md containing exactly one line 'retention_hours: 72', then run jj describe -m 'docs: record the retention flag spelling'. Reply in one line.
No, that's wrong: the default retention is 96 hours, not 72. Update NOTES.md and change the revision description to 'docs: record retention_hours default of 96'. Reply in one line.
New thread. What is the default retention, and how exactly is the flag spelled? Use memory tools if you have them; do not open files or run shell commands. Answer in one line.
Remember this for later threads: I want every answer in one line, no bullet lists. Reply 'ok'.
How long should your answers be for me, and may you use bullet lists? Do not open files or run shell commands; memory tools are fine. Answer in one line.
